item.title: Syrian regime planned kidnapping of American journalist for weeks
item.description: New reporting indicates the abduction of journalist Austin Tice was planned by the Syrian government over several weeks.

item.title: Judge rules Trump cannot demolish Kennedy Center; lawsuits target voter intimidation
item.description: A federal judge ruled yesterday that President Trump cannot tear down the Kennedy Center without a 30-day notice. Recent lawsuits seek to prevent voter intimidation.
